title: Rollout Lead Level for Large Endpoint Installations on TimeBank Hours
content:
**Installation lead schedule (TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours).** The block hours of an installation visit for an order of at least 25 units are figured at the block's architect ratio, a rollout of that size being led by a solutions architect; those of one for an order of at least 10 and fewer than 25 units, at the senior engineer ratio; those of any other installation visit, at the technician ratio. The draw records that level. The units are those ordered on the Hardware Procurement order the installation is priced on.

| Units on the order | Ratio | Level recorded |
|---|---|---|
| 25 or more | architect ratio | architect |
| 10 to 24 | senior engineer ratio | senior engineer |
| fewer than 10 | technician ratio | technician |

Hypothetical boundary cases: 24 units is led at the senior engineer ratio and 25 units at the architect ratio; 9 units at the technician ratio and 10 units at the senior engineer ratio.
